items.name: NTE: Neverness to Everness
items.description: A supernatural urban open-world RPG. As an anomaly-user who senses the “waves” of people and anomalies, you join E.T.D Squad Six and investigate the city's paranormal events.

items.name: Minecraft
items.description: A blocky sandbox where you mine, craft and build across procedurally generated worlds. Survive the night, or just keep building — alone or with friends.
